calls.thesis: First tracked Hogue TEM call (captions say 'Tempest AI' for Tempus AI): combines clinical records, genomic information and AI to help doctors choose treatments; its growing clinical/genomic library could be hard to replicate; revenue expected up 25% this year and the earnings loss narrowing to ~5c/share next year — but it burns ~$270M cash a year ($600M+ cash on hand) and faces healthcare-regulation risk, so survivability is a question mark. He recommended it on 15 July.
calls.price_at_call: Down ~27% over the last year, up ~15% since his 15 July recommendation; analyst average target $73 (~10% upside) as stated
